messages:
deploybot: Deploy paused: preflight failed for release 2026.03.18-42 -> service 'inference-gateway'. Env parity check: staging vs prod mismatch detected. Promotion blocked.

deploybot: Detected diffs (automated):
```
staging:
  s3_cache_prefix: "inference/staging/"
  keystore_prefix: "keystore/staging"
  image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference-gateway@sha256:abc123

prod:
  s3_cache_prefix: "inference/production/"
  keystore_prefix: "keystore/Prod"  # case mismatch
  image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference-gateway:latest  # tag not pinned
```

maria: ouch. two separate things here: s3 prefix and keystore casing + image pin.

sam: the canary is running the pinned digest (sha256:abc123). prod image tag drifted to :latest last night (CI pushed new tag). That explains some cache misses observed in canary metrics.

kevin: agreed — do NOT bypass. If we force promotion we'll get inconsistent cache keys and possibly stale/duplicate objects referencing wrong prefixes.

maria: what are options? backfill prod to match staging, or change staging to production prefix?

sam: safest for minimal blast radius is to alias/copy objects in S3 with a small migration job that maps inference/production/* -> inference/staging/* or vice versa depending on canonical naming. Also fix keystore by creating a lowercase alias so both paths resolve.

product-ops: note we have a customer-facing change window at 02:00 UTC. If we need a migration that requires write ops, we should run during that window.

kevin: decision proposal: 1) HOLD promotion. 2) Pin prod image to sha256:abc123 (same digest as canary) to avoid code diff. 3) Run migration script during tonight's change window to normalize s3 prefix to inference/production/ (canonicalize to prod naming) and create keystore alias 'keystore/prod' -> 'keystore/Prod' (case-insensitive alias). 4) Add release notes entry about keystore canonicalization and image pin.

maria: +1. We'll need an infra review for the keystore alias; possible IAM permissions required. @oncall-bot can you open a change request and extend the window by 30m if needed?

oncall-bot: Change request created: CR-9837. Scheduled for 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC, window +30m on request.

sam: I'll sketch the migration job now and run it in staging first. Will post the runbook and `kubectl`/aws cli snippets here.

sam: runbook draft snippet:
```bash
# dry-run: list objects that would be moved/copied
aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-inference-cache --prefix inference/production/ --query 'Contents[].Key'
# copy example
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-inference-cache/inference/production/foo s3://redwood-inference-cache/inference/staging/foo --metadata-directive COPY
```

maria: also creating ticket INFRELEASE-4321 to track migration, release-note, and postmortem. Assigning to @sam and @kevin.

kevin: i'll prepare a rollback plan: if migration shows >1% error rate we abort and revert by removing aliases and unpinning image (promote back to previous state). Keep artifacts pinned in registry to avoid auto-upgrades.

product-ops: adding a short blurb to the release notes: "Deferred promotion due to env-parity drift (S3 prefix and keystore path). Migration planned during change window; promotions will resume after verification."

maria: thanks. @deploybot it's okay to keep release flagged; don't auto-unblock.

deploybot: Release flagged: inference-gateway promotion blocked. Automatic retry disabled.

sam: I'll run staging migration in ~30m and post status.

kevin: if staging run looks good, we proceed during window. Otherwise we'll hold until Monday. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — I'll update stakeholders and add the release-note entry.

sam: staging migration completed (dry-run): 0 errors, 124 objects would be copied. Posting PR with migration script shortly.

maria: perfect. keeping hold until prod migration and final verification.

product-ops: logged customer comms and scheduled brief.

kevin: follow-up action list created in INFRELEASE-4321: [backfill-s3, keystore-alias, pin-prod-image, runbook, postmortem].

maria: good work. will reconvene after prod run.

deploybot: Noted. No further automated promotions until INFRELEASE-4321 resolved.
